content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "OUTFIT_TEXT: A soft cream-colored tunic with a modest neckline and relaxed fit, crafted from fine cotton jersey. Dark indigo straight-leg jeans in a mid-rise wash, featuring a clean hem that rests just above the ankle. Classic white leather low-top sneakers with a slightly distressed finish for comfort during the walk to church. Simple gold stud earrings and a small cross pendant necklace on a thin chain. This ensemble respects her wish for everyday modesty while accommodating the transition from church service to family lunch in autumn weather. The cream tunic provides warmth without being heavy, allowing ease of movement inside the building or walking outside after the event. Dark denim and white sneakers offer a timeless, unpretentious look that remains respectful yet comfortable enough for an entire Sunday afternoon with her parents."}
